name: Calm White Noise-Sleep better
dev: Chongqing Xinqiu Intelligent Technology Co Ltd

android.desc:
Calm White Noise is a minimalist white noise app designed to help you sleep deeper, relax faster, and focus better — without distractions.

Built for sleep, relaxation, meditation, focus, and stress relief, Calm White Noise combines soothing ambience, nature sounds, and custom recordings into one peaceful listening experience.

We believe less is more. Instead of cluttered interfaces and overwhelming features, Calm White Noise focuses on delivering calming background audio that simply works.

— Carefully Curated Soundscapes —

Enjoy 14 high-quality relaxing sounds, thoughtfully processed for a smoother and more comfortable listening experience:

Rain • Thunder • Seaside • River • Forest • Night • Campfire • Leaves • Train • Coffee Shop • Farm • Yacht • Frogs • Cat Purring

Perfect for deep sleep, studying, meditation, relaxation, and everyday focus.

— Record Your Own Ambience —

Capture the sounds that comfort you most.

Record rain outside your window, a quiet café, nighttime ambience, ocean waves, or any moment you want to revisit later. Turn your favorite environments into personal white noise and relaxing background audio.

— Multi-Sound Mixing —

Create your perfect atmosphere by combining multiple calming sounds together. Mix rain with thunder, forest with night ambience, or build your own unique soundscape for sleep and focus.

— Sleep Timer —

Set a timer and drift off naturally. Audio fades out automatically, helping you relax and sleep without interruption.

— Apple Watch Control —

Start, stop, and control playback directly from your Apple Watch — perfect for bedtime and nighttime listening.

— Designed for Simplicity —

• Clean, distraction-free interface
• Beautiful animated sound scenes
• Smooth and calming user experience
• Built from scratch with attention to every detail

— Completely Ad-Free —

No ads. No tracking. No interruptions.

Just calm, focus, relaxation, and better sleep.

Calm White Noise is ideal for:

• Better sleep and deep relaxation
• Focused work and study
• Meditation and mindfulness
• Stress and anxiety relief
• Creating peaceful daily routines

One-time purchase. Lifetime access.

Download Calm White Noise and create your perfect relaxing atmosphere anytime.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a minimalist white noise app because most of them felt bloated

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m an indie developer and recently released a small project called Calm White Noise.

I built it because most white noise / sleep apps I tried felt overcomplicated — ads, subscriptions, too many controls, or features I never used. I wanted something extremely simple: open the app, choose a sound, set a timer, and sleep.

Key ideas behind the app:
– Minimalist UI, focused on one thing only
– Carefully curated and cleaned nature sounds
– Seamless looping for long sessions
– Sleep timer support
– Completely ad-free

The app currently includes 14 nature sounds like rain, seaside, forest, night ambience, campfire, train, coffee shop, and more.

This is my first public release and I’d really appreciate any feedback — especially from people who care about simplicity, focus, or audio UX.

Google Play link:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=calm.whitenoise

Thanks for reading!
